text: dsh-weather 是面向 DSH 网页端的天气插件，在 Host 注册模型可调用的天气工具，并在网页界面的浮层区域挂载可拖动的小组件。用户可以查询中文或英文城市，查看当前温度、体感、湿度、风速及最多 7 天的天气和降水预报；小组件首次加载会尝试按 IP 定位，也可手动搜索城市。天气查询和地理编码使用 Open-Meteo，不需要 API Key；首次定位还会请求第三方 IP 定位及反向地理编码服务。

dsh-weather adds a draggable weather widget and model-callable weather tool to DSH web. Search a city to see current conditions and forecasts for up to seven days. First load tries IP-based location. Open-Meteo needs no API key; location lookup contacts third-party services.
想在 DSH 网页界面里快速看当前城市天气和未来几天预报。
让模型查询某个城市的温度、湿度、风速和降水概率。
I want a draggable weather widget in the DSH web interface that can search cities.
dsh-weather 的功能「模型天气查询」：模型调用 weather 工具并提供城市名，可选设置 1 到 7 天预报；工具返回当前天气和逐日预报摘要。
dsh-weather 的功能「网页天气浮层」：点击右下角太阳按钮打开可拖动卡片，可手动输入城市并查询，展示当前天气和最多三天的卡片预报。
dsh-weather 使用前须知：首次载入时会把访问者 IP 交给第三方定位服务，并将坐标用于反向地理编码；天气和城市查询发送至 Open-Meteo，无需 API Key。（见 src/weather.ts:239）

dsh-weather README · dsh-weather：Weather forecast for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. A draggable floating weather card in the bottom-right corner, plus a model-callable `weather` tool — with playful easter eggs. Weather data comes from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/) (free, no API key).

dsh-weather README · Features：- **Floating weather card** — a ☀️ button in the bottom-right opens a draggable card showing current conditions and a 3-day forecast.
- **Auto-locate by IP** — on first open, the card locates your city from your IP and resolves a Chinese name (e.g. 南京); it falls back to 北京 if that fails.
- **Search any city** — Chinese or English names, e.g. 北京 / 上海 / New York / Tokyo.
- **Model tool** — the agent answers "北京明天天气" / "上海要带伞吗" by calling the `weather` tool directly.
- **Easter eggs** 🍬 — weather one-liners (sunny = "宜摸鱼忌加班", ≥35° = "出门五分钟流汗两小时") and city-specific jokes (`南极` = "企鹅比人多，出门记得带鱼").
- **Theme-aware** — uses Harness design tokens, so it follows light/dark mode.

dsh-weather README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/XCKjacksparrow/dsh-weather/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz
```

Then restart `dsh web` so the Host and the browser client load the plugin.

dsh-weather README · Install from a local build：```sh
npm run build
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-weather-0.1.0.tgz
```

dsh-weather README · Usage：- Click the ☀️ button in the bottom-right, type a city, and press Enter or **查询**.
- Ask the agent anything weather-related, e.g. "上海明天要带伞吗？"

dsh-weather README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build   # build host + client bundles into lib/
npm test        # run the unit tests (node --test)
```

Built files under `lib/` are committed, so installing the plugin does not require a build step.

dsh-weather README · Data sources：- Weather: [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/) — free, no API key.
- IP geolocation: `api.ipapi.is` (primary), then `get.geojs.io` and `ipwho.is` (fallbacks).
- Chinese reverse geocoding: BigDataCloud.

> Privacy: the widget sends your IP to a third-party geolocation service once, on first open, to infer an approximate city. Nothing is stored.
